reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given elsewhere this month, A answers my worries directly: all-or-nothing refund guarantee, $11,000 already pledged in writing so only $49,000 is left, quarterly spending reports, a reopening date, and candour about the roof estimate and film timing.
